newsitem.title: DENMARK: Denmark sees state debt rising again in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Denmark sees state debt rising again in 1997.

text.p: Denmark's net state debt is expected to rise to 637.2 billion crowns in 1997, 26 billion crowns higher than expected in 1996, according to the government's 1997 draft state budget issued on Tuesday.
This meant the Danish state would have to pay 53.8 billion crowns in interest on its debt to its international and domestic creditors next year, it said.
It said 1997's state debt corresponded to 60.2 percent of estimated GDP, pointing to a net borrowing requirement of 86 billion crowns next year, 18 billion crowns down on 1996.
